official_definition: You can Contract Advent onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When Contract Advent onto this Brave, you can Brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit. When you've done so, you can add one of your "The Partner Pentan" , including those that are in Soul State, to underneath this Spirit as a pre-advent card.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Contract Reload] or [Contract Reload: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Contract Reload]", "give [Contract Reload]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
